instruction: Access the FlightAware community discussions and select the conversation that has the greatest number of reply posts.

metadata.explanation: Task requires identifying and opening the discussion thread with the most reply posts. Evaluator checks if user successfully navigated to the correct URL representing the most-replied discussion.

llm_judge_reasons: Incomplete verification: Instruction requires identifying the thread with MOST replies, but evaluator only checks navigation to a hardcoded URL without verifying it actually has the most replies
No verification of comparison logic: The task requires comparing reply counts across multiple discussions, but the evaluator doesn't verify this analysis was performed

Static expected value without justification: The expected URL 'https://discussions.flightaware.com/t/the-banter-thread/4412' is hardcoded with no metadata showing when/how it was verified to have the most replies
Brittle to data changes: If website content changes and a different thread gains more replies, the evaluator would still pass the old URL, making it semantically incorrect
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Use get_info_from_website getter to dynamically extract reply counts from multiple discussion threads
Add metric logic to verify the selected thread actually has the maximum reply count among all threads
Include metadata with timestamp and verification of which thread had most replies when task was created
Consider adding a backup getter to fetch current discussion list and reply counts to validate the expected answer is still correct
